question: How much percentage of oxygen is present in the atmosphere?
solution: The correct answer is __21%__ __ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** • Air is a mixture of gases that surrounds the earth. • It consists of different gases. • About 21% of atmospheric air contains Oxygen. • It is the second most abundant gas in the atmosphere. • Nitrogen is the most abundant gas. • Carbon dioxide, argon, and methane are found in minute quantities.
